Impact from the removal of each gear on the YPR and SPR in the specified period.

Source: R/BLICC_Tables.R
blicc_impact.Rd

The change in YPR and SPR are calculated for each parameter set to produce a tibble of the YPR and SPR change from the removal of each gear in sequence. This is only useful if there is more than one gear.

Usage

blicc_impact(blicc_rp)

Arguments

blicc_rp

A list of posterior draws, reference points with associated direction, the data object and expected lengths from blicc_ref_pts function.

Value

A tibble with the changes in YPR and SPR from the removal of each gear for the scenario in blicc result list.

Examples

blicc_impact(blicc_ref_pts(blicc_mpd(trgl_ld), trgl_ld))
